critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/players.py:update_player_contact — spieler_id branch mirrors the other fields (trim + '' → None) and is guarded by the same 'not upd → 400' contract. Partial update semantics correct.
backend/models.py:Player — spieler_id: Optional[str] = None default lets legacy DB docs without the field deserialize cleanly (verified with GET /api/players against seeded data).

frontend/src/PlayerEditSheet.tsx:117-152 — save() always sends every contact field on every save. Sending '' for un-touched fields relies on backend '' → None. For jersey it correctly translates blank to jerseyNum=0 → backend treats <=0 as null. Not a bug but worth documenting that opening + saving the sheet is effectively 'set all contact fields to what the form currently shows'.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Temporarily set josh-ankermann.spieler_id='SL-12345678' and filip-la.spieler_id='SL-9999' during the flows; both cleaned back to null via PATCH /contact {spieler_id:''}. Verified via GET /api/players after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coach password is 'pw12345' (NOT 'test1234' as older memos suggested). PlayerEditSheet exposes testID='input-spieler-id' (below testID='input-jersey'). Row tap testID pattern is 'kader-row-{playerId}'. When tapping Kader tab from Playwright, use a[href*='/kader'] — no testID on tab bar items yet.
